newsitem.title: CONGO: Congo militia takes Brazzaville centre.
newsitem.headline: Congo militia takes Brazzaville centre.

text.p: A political militia fighting loyalist troops in the Congo capital Brazzaville on Sunday occupied most of the city centre and surrounded the prime minister's office and treasury, western military sources said.
"The Cobras (militia) have taken the centre of town and are heading for the town hall. They have captured a number of small armoured vehicles and light tanks from the army," one source said.

The militia loyal to ex-president Denis Sassou Nguesso has been fighting soldiers loyal to President Pascal Lissouba for four days after troops surrounded Sassou Nguesso's home to enforce a ban on private militias in the runup to elections.
Officials at the presidency on Sunday said discussions had begun with representatives of Sassou Nguesso and other political leaders, but said the message had not reached the fighters.
